images.label: Golden Cavern Awakening
images.prompt: A vast, bioluminescent dragon bone cavern lit by radiant golden light emanating from a floating jade tablet covered in glowing, accelerating code lines; central figure Lin Jin stands barefoot, arms raised, his veins pulsing with golden data-light, surrounded by swirling holographic data streams and fractured digital geometry; cyberpunk/sci-fi style, wide-angle low-angle composition, dramatic volumetric lighting with strong rim glow and ethereal god-rays piercing from above.

images.label: Void Core Confrontation
images.prompt: Lin Jin suspended mid-air inside a void-like data dimension, eyes closed, body wrapped in luminous golden energy tendrils; before him floats a jagged black crystal core emitting faint violet static, while a massive, softly glowing dragon heart hovers nearby, pulsing rhythmically; anime-style sci-fi rendering, centered symmetrical composition, high-contrast chiaroscuro lighting with deep indigo shadows and sharp golden highlights on skin and crystal edges.

images.label: Crystal Shatter Moment
images.prompt: Extreme close-up of Lin Jin's hand gripping a cracked obsidian-black crystal that fractures under golden light explosion; micro-details show data particles dissolving into light, golden shockwave rippling across the surface; sci-fi cinematic style, tight macro framing, dynamic backlighting with intense specular bloom, shallow depth of field, ambient glow reflecting on sweat-dampened forearm skin and crystalline shards.
